text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
—Hell yeah! We're gonna have a total blast 
todayyy!! 
I'll make sure Beauty-san has the time of 
her life!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
H-Hey, don't yell her name out loud! 
Beauty-san is technically incognito right 
now, remember?

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: It's fine. I'm in disguise. And besides...

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
Is that person... Beauty Anshinzawa...? 
Nah, looks a bit off. Whew, just a 
lookalike, huh.

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
See? Nobody noticed, right? 
It feels like I've completely lost my 
aura... *sigh*

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry about it! I'm sure you'll get 
it right back! 
Anyway, let's just go all over the place 
and have some fun today!

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
You're right... You did go out of your way 
to take me out. 
It'd be a waste to sit around moping. 
Alright, let's have a blast~!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Allow me to introduce you. This is Ms. 
Betta-nabe. 
I thought the two of you stylish ladies 
would hit it off.

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
A Halfmoon Betta! Those frills are so 
beauty... but... 
Right now, I wanna see some squishy, 
chubby seals! Kyahaa!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Hey, don't run off! Good grief... 
Is she trying to keep her distance from 
"beauty" right now...?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Over here, Beauty-san! 
Look, isn't this a great view? You can 
even see the academy from here.

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Where, where~?! Wow, what a stunning 
view~☆ 
It's so high! So spacious! My energy is 
shooting right up~!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, since it's so clear today, you can 
see really far. 
Oh, they have binoculars here too...!

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Kyahahaha! Ufufufu~~~~♪

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Wait up~! 
...Heheh, looks like she's completely 
cheered up!

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Yes! So much! It's been forever since I 
had this much fun! 
I don't care about slumps or fashion 
anymoooore!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Pheeew, we sure played our hearts out! 
Well then, how about we grab some dinner 
before heading back?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Sounds good. 
Beauty-san, is there anything you'd like 
to eat—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(Is Beauty-san... looking at that clothing 
boutique?)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: U-Um, Beauty-san...!

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Oh! We were talking about dinner, weren't 
we? Let's see...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
No, well... um... 
Aren't you actually still thinking about 
your work?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
If you don't mind, I'd like to hear more 
about your slump. 
They say just talking about it can make 
your heart feel lighter...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I see, that's definitely important too. 
Alright! Feel free to vent or tell us 
anything you want, Beauty-san!

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
—How it started... well. I suppose it 
was... 
when a client didn't like my design...

text_block_list.name: Client
text_block_list.text:
"Hmm... Not feeling it. It kind of looks 
like an old-fashioned dress. 
I want it cuter, like, more sparkly~ and 
fluffy~!

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
"You don't care for a chic style? ...Okay! 
Then how about we add more frills here to 
give it a cuter—"

text_block_list.name: Client
text_block_list.text:
"Not like that...! More like sweet, but 
still normally cool, y'know? 
Actually, just take it in a completely 
different direction! Something trendy like 
yami-kawaii!"

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
(Wha—! That's the fifth time she's flipped 
the table on me! 
My design should be the absolute best, and 
yet...!)

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
(Wait, is it not the 'best'? That can't 
be...! 
I'm certain this brings out her beauty so 
much more...!)

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
(What an impenetrable girl...! How can our 
visions of beauty align? 
Where is true beauty? Hmmm? Nnnngh~~~?!)

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: —What even *is* "beauty" anymore...?!"

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I personally think Beauty-san's designs 
are wonderful, but... 
Once she started doubting herself, outside 
opinions probably stopped meaning anything 
to her.

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
*sniffle*... You're right. I just can't 
believe in myself anymore. 
No matter how many times I try, it's no 
good... Everything I draw feels so lame.

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Even when designing, my heart doesn't 
flutter at all anymore... 
I hate it. Looking at it, thinking about 
it—it all just hurts...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
To think doing the job you love could 
become so painful. 
Hmmmm, that's really tough...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Tough, you say? Isn't that actually quite 
common?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Is it? Because when it comes to racing, 
the higher the wall, the more fired up you 
get, right? 
It makes you wanna go, 'I'll keep at it 
until I win!'

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. That's very like you, Hishi Ama-san. 
However, people who can think that way are 
in the minority.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Effort and return are always on the 
scales. 
Most people begin to suffer when their 
efforts go unrewarded.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
A wall, huh... Yeah, I guess so... 
It really sucks when all you get are lame 
results...
